text:
Zara: quick alert — onboarding demo causing bursts of 429s during initial pagination load.
Zara: demo prefetches 12 pages in parallel to populate cards.
Zara: sample response: 429, Retry-After: 4, X-RI-Quota: 2/60, X-RI-Reset: 58
Ilya (sdk): which SDKs? we shipped a higher prefetch default in python v1.7 but not in js.
Zara: backend python-sdk v1.7.0, frontend js-sdk v1.5.0.
Ben (platform): logs show many concurrent token refresh attempts; when they retry we hit the quota ceiling.
Cass (oncall): classic backpressure: expired tokens -> concurrent refreshes -> retry storm -> quota exhausted.
Ilya (sdk): parity bug: JS coalesces refresh, python doesnt for async flows. quick fix: add per-credential refresh lock and drop prefetch default to 3 for trial installs. also honor Retry-After header.
Ilya (sdk): pseudocode:
```
if token_expired():
  if refresh_in_progress(cred):
    wait_for_refresh(cred)
  else:
    start_refresh(cred)
on_429(resp):
  wait = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 1))
  sleep(max(backoff * 2**attempt, wait))
```
Ben (platform): can SDK parse X-RI-Quota and switch to conservative mode when remaining <=3? edge can add a tiny smoothing bucket for UI-originated bursts while we roll the SDK.
Cass (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) flip DEMO_PREFETCH=1 in sample app (Zara) 2) SDK hotfix for auth dedupe + retry-after (Ilya) 3) platform edge smoothing toggle for trial bucket (Ben) 4) postmortem + comms (Cass).
Zara: flipped env and deployed to staging. ci-bot: deploy-staging succeeded for demo-app @ 2026-06-02T15:12:10Z
Ilya (sdk): opening PR with auth coalesce + default change, adding unit test for concurrent refresh and integration test for low X-RI-Quota handling. ETA 6h.
Ben (platform): will enable edge smoothing for trial traffic for 2 hours to cover rollout.
Cass (oncall): will draft incident note and onboarding doc update: "trial users: set DEMO_PREFETCH<=2 and upgrade SDK for auth coalescing".
Zara: thanks everyone — ping here if any residual 429s after release.
